TEAM.INTRO: Invite your company's people and set their role. Each gets an email to activate their account.
TEAM.INTRO_OWN: Your delegates. Each person you invite gets an email to activate their account.
TEAM.NO_NAME: No name. Edit it to recognize this person.
TEAM.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the team.
TEAM.EMPTY_TITLE: There is nobody on the team yet
TEAM.EMPTY_BODY: When you add someone, they will show up here.
TEAM.EMPTY_FILTERED_BODY: Try another role, status or group, or clear the filters.

GROUPS.INTRO_ADMIN: Owners form groups that you lead; each owner can lead a team of delegates.
GROUPS.INTRO_OWN: Your team of delegates. Create it to invite delegates.
GROUPS.CREATE_RESPONSABLES_HELP: For example “Owners - AI service”. The “Responsables” group already exists by default and its name is reserved.
GROUPS.CREATE_TEAM_HELP: The team of delegates of an owner. Each owner leads a single team.
GROUPS.NO_ELIGIBLE: All your owners already have a team, or there are no owners yet.
GROUPS.CREATE_OWN_HELP: Give it any name you like. You can lead only one team.
GROUPS.EMPTY_BODY_ADMIN: Groups of owners and teams of delegates will show up here once you create them.
GROUPS.EMPTY_BODY_OWN: Once you create your team, it will show up here.
GROUPS.MEMBERS_ERROR: We could not load the people of this group.
GROUPS.NO_DESTINATION: There is no other team to move them to.
GROUPS.MOVE_CONFIRM_BODY: They carry out {{count}} controls. If you move them, those controls will have no executor and will stay with their current owner.

ERROR.MOVE_TARGET: We could not move the person: the destination team does not exist or its owner is no longer active.

GROUPS.TITLE: Groups
GROUPS.NEW_SUBTITLE: Create an owners group or the team of one of them.
GROUPS.DETAIL_SUBTITLE: Who leads the group and the people in it.

INVITE.TITLE: Invite a person
INVITE.NAME: First name
INVITE.EMAIL_TAKEN: There is already a user registered with that email.
INVITE.ALREADY_IN_TEAM: There is already a user registered with that email: {{who}} ({{role}}).
INVITE.NO_TEAMS_ADMIN: No owner has a team yet. Create one from the org chart to invite delegates.
INVITE.NO_TEAM_OWN: You do not have a team yet. Create it to invite delegates.
INVITE.HELP_ADMIN_EMPRESA: An administrator manages the team, assigns the owner of each control and validates what is uploaded, like you.
INVITE.HELP_RESPONSABLE: An owner is in charge of controls, reviews what their team uploads and splits the execution among their delegates.
INVITE.HELP_DELEGADO: A delegate carries out the controls their owner assigns and uploads the evidence. Choose whether they are from your company or external.
INVITE.HELP_AUDITOR: An auditor reviews everything in your company read-only and leaves observations.
INVITE.TEAM_NAME_HELP: If you leave it empty it will be called “Team of” plus their name.
INVITE.SUBTITLE: They will get an email to activate their account.

INVITATION.SENT_BODY: They will get an email with their activation code. The code works only once and expires on {{date}}. If they cannot find it, ask them to check the spam folder.
INVITATION.FAILED_TITLE: We could not send the invitation to {{email}}
INVITATION.FAILED_BODY: The account was created, but the email did not go out. Resend the invitation so they get a new code; the previous one will stop working.

CONFIRM.DEACTIVATE_BODY: Their session closes immediately and they will not be able to sign in again until you reactivate them. What they already did is kept.
CONFIRM.RESET_MFA_BODY: Their sessions are closed and, on their next sign-in, they will set up the second factor again. Use it only if they lost their phone and their recovery codes.

NOTICE.CODE_REISSUED: We issued a new code. The previous one no longer works.

ERROR.SAVE: We could not save the change. Try again.
ERROR.USER_LIMIT: You reached the contracted user limit. Deactivate an account or contact Monkey to increase it.
ERROR.USER_LIMIT_COUNTS: You reached the contracted user limit ({{count}} of {{max}}). Deactivate an account or contact Monkey to increase it.
ERROR.NO_TEAM: This owner has no team of delegates yet. Create it from the org chart.
ERROR.TEAM_NOT_CREATED: The person was created, but we could not create their team. Create it from the org chart.

ACTION_DESC.EDIT_NAME: Correct this person's first and last name.
ACTION_DESC.RESEND_INVITATION: Sends the invitation to the account's email again.
ACTION_DESC.RESET_MFA: Ends their sessions; on their next sign-in they will set up the second factor again.
ACTION_DESC.DEACTIVATE: Ends their session at once and keeps them out until you reactivate them.
ACTION_DESC.REACTIVATE: Gives them access to their account again.

ORG.TITLE: Org chart
ORG.INTRO_ADMIN: Who reports to whom: administrators on top, each owner with their team of delegates, and auditors apart.
ORG.INTRO_OWN: Your team: you as an owner and the delegates who work with you.
ORG.EMPTY: There is nobody on the team yet. Invite the first person from “People”.
ORG.AUDITORS_HELP: Outside the chain: they read everything read-only and are not given controls.
ORG.ORPHANS_HELP: Their owner is deactivated. Move them to another owner from “People” when you need to.
ORG.NO_TEAM_ADMIN: They have no team yet; without one, delegates cannot be assigned to them.
ORG.NO_TEAM_OWN: You do not have a team yet. Create it to invite delegates.
ORG.NO_DESTINATION: There is no other owner with a team to move them to.
ORG.MOVE_CONFIRM_BODY: They run {{count}} controls. If you change them, those controls will have no executor and stay with their current owner.

ERROR.MOVE_TARGET: We could not move the person: the destination team does not exist or its owner is no longer active.
